derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth;

occurrences.text: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben–hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben–zoheth.
